source: 시안 — 저장소를 만들기 전(2026-10-30) 손으로 쓴 지시문. 설계표(traits·worlds)의 바탕이 됐다
prompt:
CONCEPT: a citizen of the Iron Nation — the nation of the element of tools, weapons and blood: heavy, grounded, industrious. Each citizen is a personification of one substance or use of that element.
CITIZEN: NAIL (the future). A female personification character with a steel nail as her motif — the nail reimagined as a woman in a construction worker's hard-surface suit that carries its materials, colors, shape and motifs: brushed steel grey, a flat round nail-head as a helmet disc or hair crown, a tall slim pointed silhouette, rivet and bolt details, hazard-orange accents. She does NOT hold a nail; it is not a separate object. Both hands are ordinary human hands and hold nothing.
ERA: THE FUTURE, year 2080 — an orbital construction site above Earth: steel trusses of a space habitat under assembly, the curve of the planet and a thin blue atmosphere below, a welding robot arm in the distance, hard sunlight and deep shadow of space. Her suit is practical near-future engineering gear (sealed, with a small helmet ring), not fantasy and not a battle mecha.
STYLE: Polished 2.5D game key art with clean linework, controlled anime facial design, layered cel-to-soft shading and crisp costume and prop detail. Use a vivid, readable silhouette and campaign-quality lighting.
OUTPUT: one character image that works as card art. Vertical 2:3 frame, full body with head and feet inside the frame with clear margins, face turned toward the camera (front or three-quarter). Standing, card-ready pose; environment may be rich while her design stays fully readable.
BODY: a normal human body — one head, two arms and two legs, each joined at its natural joint. Hands and feet may be partly hidden by the pose or the frame.
ONE FIGURE ONLY. No second character, no creature, no text, no lettering, no logo, no watermark, no speech bubble, no frame border.
ANATOMY: natural adult proportions, both hands drawn correctly as hands. No extra limbs.
